title: Penthouse June 1988 Pet of the Year Play-Off Chinese Mafia Complete Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers bright; wear and small chips along the spine edge and corners. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, June 1988 - Pet of the Year Play-Off issue, original $4.00 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Cover features: Pet of the Year Play-Off; The Chinese Mafia in America.

Back cover: Carlton menthol cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
